name: smwmusic-pok-mon-diamond-pearl-platinum-canalave-city-day
title: Pokémon Diamond/Pearl/Platinum - Canalave City (Day)
description:
Very calm & peaceful music from Pokémon DPPt.
Cound fit well with water levels or cutscen.
I sacrificed some vanilla samples for quality, thus it's using tight ARAM. Please use with caution.

This song will change some instruments of following SFX:
Death, Yoshi, P-Switch, Bonus-end, Starman&Shatter&Grinder(@22)

Also this is not compatible with:
Thunder, Fireworks, Blargg
